title: Underwater Library Battle
description: A vibrant fantasy scene set in an underwater ruin features a glowing purple mermaid-like sorceress floating above a stone platform, a white rabbit samurai in blue armor, a female adventurer in purple, and a red armored warrior. Below in the water, an orca and a diver swim beneath the broken floor. Floating books and glowing particles surround a massive ancient tree with sprawling roots.
prompt: A dynamic fantasy battle scene inside a flooded ancient library ruin. A glowing purple cosmic mermaid sorceress with long flowing hair floats above a broken stone platform. A white rabbit samurai in blue armor stands ready with a katana. To the left a young black female adventurer in purple outfit runs forward, while a red armored samurai warrior stands on the right. Below the cracked floor an orca whale and a diver swim in deep blue water. A massive ancient tree with glowing roots fills the background as books float through beams of magical light, vibrant colors, cinematic lighting.
